Add dimension arrows

Source: R/single_cell_visualize.R
add_dimension_arrows.Rd

Adds two short arrows with the dimension names (e.g. "UMAP-1", "UMAP-2") to the bottom left corner of an embedding plot and removes its axes, a compact replacement for full axes. Works on any ggplot, e.g. from Seurat::DimPlot(); the package's own embedding plots draw these arrows themselves.

The arrows keep a fixed proportion to the panel they are drawn in: the sizes below are those of a panel 3.5 inches on its shorter side, and everything (lengths, line width, label size) is scaled with the panel's actual size when the plot is drawn. A small panel gets small arrows that stay clear of the cells, a large one arrows that are not lost in it. `arrow.scale` makes them bigger or smaller at any panel size.

Usage

add_dimension_arrows(
  plot,
  reduction = "umap",
  dims = NULL,
  arrow.scale = 1,
  arrow.length = 2,
  x.coord.adjust = 0.25,
  y.coord.adjust = x.coord.adjust,
  arrow.size = 0.25,
  arrow.width = 0.2,
  arrow.line.width = 3,
  arrow.color = "black",
  text.font.size = 12,
  text.dst = 0.3,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object

reduction

The reduction method used to generate the plot, default is "umap", allowed values are "umap", "tsne", "pca", "spatial"

dims

A vector of dimension names, overwrites the default dimension names assumed from reduction method

arrow.scale

Size of the arrows relative to the panel, default is 1: arrows 2 cm long on a panel of 3.5 inches (about 23% of its shorter side), scaled with the panel. Use e.g. 0.8 for smaller or 1.25 for larger arrows

arrow.length

The length of the arrows in cm on a 3.5-inch panel, default is 2

x.coord.adjust

Horizontal adjustment of the arrow origin in cm on a 3.5-inch panel, default is 0.25

y.coord.adjust

Vertical adjustment of the arrow origin, default is the same as `x.coord.adjust`

arrow.size

The length of the arrow head in cm on a 3.5-inch panel, default is 0.25

arrow.width

The width of the arrow head in cm on a 3.5-inch panel, default is 0.2

arrow.line.width

The width of the arrow line on a 3.5-inch panel (in R's `lwd` units), default is 3

arrow.color

The color of the arrow and label, default is "black"

text.font.size

The font size of the labels in points on a 3.5-inch panel, default is 12

text.dst

The distance of the labels from the arrows in cm on a 3.5-inch panel, default is 0.3

...

Deprecated snake_case names of the arguments above (e.g. `arrow_length`), accepted with a warning; renamed to dot.case in 0.10.0

Value

a ggplot object with the dimension arrows added
